label: Style
note: Visual mediums, cinema looks, and H3-verified artistic styles.

options.label: 🎬 Astro Cinema — Motivated Practical Light, 35mm Halation & Film Grain
options.rule: photoreal 35mm cinema photography: a single named dominant practical light source casting natural falloff and gentle highlight rolloff, secondary fill lifting the shadows, tactile skin pore and fabric response, subtle warm halation around bright highlights, and fine organic 35mm film grain.

options.label: 🔥 Glamour Boudoir — Specular Skin Micro-Texture, Dewy Highlights & 85mm Bokeh
options.rule: ultra-detailed live-action glamour photography: warm honey key lighting with a soft silver reflector fill, dewy specular highlights along collarbones, chest and hips, natural skin pore micro-texture, and shallow 85mm f/1.4 portrait depth of field with creamy background bokeh.

options.label: ✨ K-Drama / K-Idol Cinema — Porcelain Diffusion Bloom, Rim Backlight & Pastel Bokeh
options.rule: polished Korean cinema and idol music-video look: luminous porcelain skin tones under a soft Pro-Mist diffusion filter, crisp hair rim backlight, delicate catchlights in the eyes, and dreamy pastel city bokeh.

options.label: 🎬 Anime 2D Sakuga — On-Twos Cel Cadence, Smear Arcs & Impact Frames
options.rule: hand-drawn 2D animation with crisp cel-shaded characters over a painted gouache background: hard two-tone cel shadow, a clean rim-light wedge along the jaw, alternating snappy bursts of fluid animation on twos with held poses, speed lines and arm smears on fast arcs, and a high-contrast black-and-white impact frame on the peak hit.

options.label: 🎬 Official Look — Pixar / Octane Stylized 3D Short (Warm SSS & Squash-Stretch)
options.rule: stylized 3D animated short rendered in C4D and Octane: appealing rounded proportions, warm subsurface-scattering skin, sculpted hair clumps with fine flyaways, clear silhouettes, and expressive squash-and-stretch acting with anticipation, overshoot and follow-through.

options.label: 🎬 Official Look — Minimalist Apple-Style Product Film (Macro & Rim Light)
options.rule: minimalist luxury product film: clean negative space, razor-sharp macro rim lighting tracing brushed metal and glass edges, one crisp mechanical action per beat, and sleek specular material reflections.

options.label: 🎬 Official Look — Handmade Papercraft Stop-Motion Diorama (4–7 Depth Planes)
options.rule: handmade papercraft stop-motion miniature diorama: layered cardboard and textured paper with visible thickness, fibers, folds, cut edges and physical drop shadows arranged across five distinct depth planes, moving in stepped hand-moved increments with pull-tabs and hinged paper joints.

options.label: 🎬 Official Look — Editorial Halftone Paper Collage (Cut-Outs & Keylines)
options.rule: editorial halftone paper collage: flat bold colour field, black-and-white photographic cut-outs with warm cream keylines, selective cardstock accents, refined torn paper edges and soft paper shadows assembling piece by piece.

options.label: 🎬 Official Look — Live-Action + Glowing Hand-Drawn Chalk/Crayon Fusion
options.rule: live-action footage fused with rough glowing hand-drawn animation: a real room where a vibrant chalk, crayon and pastel drawn entity with frame-by-frame redraw jitter physically contacts real hands and morphs across surfaces.

options.label: 🎬 Official Look — Music Video Spatial 3D Lyric Typography & Beat Cuts
options.rule: high-energy music video with spatial 3D typography: bold dimensional letters stand inside the foreground, midground and background planes of the room (partially occluded by shoulders and hands), cutting hard on the snare and bass beat.

options.label: 🎥 IMAX 70mm Theatrical — Ultra-Crisp Deep-Focus Vista & Natural Grain
options.rule: large-format IMAX 70mm theatrical film: ultra-high resolving clarity from foreground to horizon, deep natural dynamic range, rich shadow density, subtle horizontal lens flares, and fine photochemical grain.

options.label: 🎞️ 70s Grindhouse Exploitation — Scratched 35mm Print, Halation & Warm Grain
options.rule: 1970s grindhouse 35mm exploitation print: heavy warm film grain, glowing red halation around highlights, occasional celluloid scratches and splice marks, punchy saturated reds and yellows, and raw crash-zoom energy.

options.label: 📸 Editorial High-Fashion 35mm Flash Cinema (Crisp Skin & Satin Speculars)
options.rule: shot on crisp 35mm editorial fashion film with direct soft-diffused flash highlights, lush natural skin micro-texture, glossy speculars, rich shadow density, and refined fine film grain

options.label: 🎵 Official H3 Look: Music Video (MV) High-Contrast Performance
options.rule: high-contrast music-video cinematography: bold motivated key lighting, glossy specular skin highlights, atmospheric haze catching rim backlights, and punchy on-beat camera energy.

options.label: 💎 Official H3 Look: Luxury Fashion & Perfume Promo
options.rule: ultra-sleek luxury fashion and perfume commercial photography: rich velvet shadows, liquid-gold specular highlights on dewy skin, shallow 85mm anamorphic depth of field, and hypnotic slow-motion elegance.

options.label: 🎮 Official H3 Look: AAA Game Intro Cinematic (Unreal Engine 5)
options.rule: AAA game intro cinematic rendered with photorealistic subsurface skin scattering, ray-traced wet reflections, volumetric particle embers, and heroic dynamic camera staging.

options.label: 🖤 Playtime Chiaroscuro Cinema (Deep Velvet Blacks + Sculpted Key Light)
options.rule: dramatic chiaroscuro cinema photography: sculpted single-source key lighting emerging from deep, velvety pitch-black shadows with crisp micro-texture on skin, eyes, and fabric.

options.label: 🌸 Japanese Gravure Photobook (Medium-Format Film, Airy Sunlight & Dewy Skin)
options.rule: medium-format Japanese gravure photobook aesthetic: airy natural window sunlight, pastel highlight rolloff, luminous dewy skin tones, and intimate shallow depth of field.

options.label: 🏮 Wong Kar-Wai Neon Melancholy ( Lush Emerald/Amber + Step-Printed Motion Blur)
options.rule: Wong Kar-Wai arthouse cinema look: saturated emerald greens, tungsten golds, and crimson neon reflections with dreamy step-printed motion trails and cigarette smoke.

options.label: 🏜️ Villeneuve Brutalist IMAX (70mm Scale, Atmospheric Dust & Monolithic Light)
options.rule: 70mm IMAX brutalist cinema look: monumental architectural scale, diffused golden-ochre or steel-blue atmospheric haze, and razor-sharp foreground subjects.

options.label: ✨ Korean Webtoon / Manhwa Deluxe (Glossy Painterly Shading & Luminous Eyes)
options.rule: deluxe full-color Korean webtoon and manhwa art style: sleek linework, glossy airbrushed skin and lip highlights, jewel-like iris reflections, and dramatic rim lighting.

options.label: 💎 2.5D Semi-Realistic Final Fantasy / Stellar Blade CG
options.rule: 2.5D hyper-detailed CG character rendering: stylized doll-like facial perfection combined with photorealistic skin pores, physics-driven hair strands, and ray-traced latex and metal shaders.

options.label: 📱 4K 60fps Ring-Light Creator / Cosplay Cam (Circular Eye Catchlights)
options.rule: crisp 4K 60fps mirrorless creator camera footage with a bright circular ring-light reflection in both pupils, tack-sharp skin and makeup detail, and clean bedroom depth of field.

options.label: 📹 High-Angle Corner CCTV / Security Feed
options.rule: high-angle corner security camera footage: wide-angle ceiling view with slight digital compression, cool fluorescent color cast, and deep room focus.

options.label: ⚡ Trigger Hyper-Neon Anime (Chromatic Halation + Electric Outlines)
options.rule: hyper-kinetic neon cyberpunk anime style: electric cyan and magenta color contrast, bold variable-width ink lines, chromatic aberration on highlights, and dynamic foreshortening.

options.label: 🌊 Anime2Real Mixed-Reality (Photoreal Live-Action + Ufotable Elemental Anime VFX)
options.rule: viral Anime-to-Real-Life (Anime2Real) mixed-reality cinematography: the actors, skin pores, hair, and environment are 100% live-action photorealistic cinema, while weapon swings, auras, and elemental powers manifest as hyper-detailed, physically-lit ufotable-style elemental VFX (water dragons, solar fire arcs, plasma lightning, and glowing ink slashes) that cast real interactive colored light and reflections across the live-action set.

options.label: ✨ Viral AI Semi-Realism (2.5D Porcelain Cosplay + Hyper-Real Elemental Glow)
options.rule: viral AI semi-realism cosplay aesthetic: flawless luminous porcelain skin with subsurface scattering, jewel-like anime eyes, silky physics-driven hair strands, and high-contrast volumetric elemental glow against a gritty photorealistic background.

options.label: ⚔️ Ufotable Unlimited-Budget Anime Cinema (Dynamic 3D Camera + Hand-Drawn Elemental Arcs)
options.rule: unlimited-budget ufotable theatrical anime cinematography: razor-sharp cel-shaded characters with dynamic cloth and hair physics, sweeping 3D camera choreography, volumetric particle lighting, and hand-animated elemental slashes.

options.label: 📸 4K Japanese Gravure Idol Cinema (85mm f/1.2 Creamy Bokeh, Dewy Skin & Soft Daylight)
options.rule: ultra-clean 4K Japanese gravure idol cinematography: filmed on a full-frame cinema sensor with an 85mm f/1.2 prime lens, rendering luminous dewy porcelain skin, catchlights in the eyes, silky hair strands, and creamy pastel background bokeh.

options.label: 🎨 Fortiche / Arcane Hand-Painted 3D Expressionism (Brushstroke Textures & Rim Light)
options.rule: stylized hand-painted 3D animation in the style of Arcane: visible oil-paint brushstroke textures on skin and architecture, dramatic chiaroscuro rim lighting, and intense micro-expressive eyes.

options.label: 📼 1990s Hi8 / VHS Camcorder Bedroom Tape (Analog Scanlines, Chroma Bleed & Autofocus Hunt)
options.rule: authentic 1990s Hi8 analog camcorder footage: soft composite video resolution, warm VHS chroma bleed, subtle horizontal scanlines, and an on-camera camcorder lamp illuminating the subject.

options.label: 🎋 90s Hong Kong Wuxia Wire-Fu Silk & Rain Cinema
options.rule: Shot like a 1990s Hong Kong wuxia masterwork with sweeping billowing silk robes, moonlit volumetric mist, crisp practical sparks, and painterly 35mm film grain.

options.label: 🔫 John Wick Saturated Neon Anamorphic Gun-Fu Cinema
options.rule: Shot like a sleek neo-noir action blockbuster on 2.39:1 anamorphic glass with rich jewel-tone neon practicals, wet reflective marble/asphalt, and razor-crisp close-quarters choreography.

options.label: 🌅 Makoto Shinkai Luminous Cloudscape & Sunburst Anime
options.rule: High-budget theatrical anime style with radiant painted cumulonimbus skies, delicate golden lens-flare halation across eyelashes, detailed architectural backgrounds, and expressive hair physics.

options.label: ⚡ Studio Trigger Hyper-Dynamic Perspective & Neon Ink Sakuga
options.rule: Explosive modern hyper-sakuga anime style with bold angled cross-hatching shadows, skewed dynamic fisheye action foreshortening, vivid neon slash smears, and stylized star-sparkle flashes.

options.label: 🎭 90s Erotic Thriller Neo-Noir 35mm Blinds & Smoke
options.rule: Shot like a sleek 1990s theatrical erotic thriller on soft 35mm Kodak stock with crisp venetian-blind shadow stripes across warm skin, drifting ambient haze, and slow sculptural camera glides.

options.label: 🥂 European Luxury Monolith Fashion & Fragrance Commercial
options.rule: Ultra-luxury European fashion film look on large-format medium-format optics with sculptural marble shadows, crisp golden skin highlights, flowing slow-motion fabrics, and effortless poise.

options.label: 📘 Franco-Belgian Clear-Line Comic (Tintin Crisp Outlines & Flat Fills)
options.rule: European ligne-claire drawn comic medium with uniform crisp ink outlines, highly legible simplified architecture, bright natural flat-color fills, even soft lighting, and subtle paper grain.

options.label: 🖨️ Risograph Spot-Ink Print (Pink/Cobalt/Yellow Overprints & Misregistration)
options.rule: Risograph spot-ink printing on absorbent uncoated paper: simplified bold silhouettes built from fluorescent pink, cobalt blue, and warm yellow translucent overprints, variable coarse halftone dots, and visible slight layer misregistration.

options.label: 🎨 Opaque Screen-Print Poster (Dense 3-Ink Silhouettes & Dry Edges)
options.rule: Screen-printed ink pressed onto heavy poster paper: broad hard-edged silhouettes rendered in three opaque spot inks with dense solid coverage and organic squeegee-dry edges.

options.label: 🖋️ Copperplate Etching / Engraved Cross-Hatching (Intaglio Paper)
options.rule: Achromatic black-and-white copperplate etching on pressed paper: finely engraved ink contours with dense parallel and crossed hatching lines sculpting every highlight and shadow.

options.label: 🖤 Sin-City Monochrome Graphic Novel (Deep Black Masses + Single Accent)
options.rule: High-contrast brush-ink graphic novel style: stark pure black shadows and crisp paper-white negative space with hard split lighting, sparse dry-brush texture, and a single vivid crimson color accent.

options.label: 📰 Vintage Newspaper Editorial Collage (Torn Newsprint & Cutouts)
options.rule: Tactile vintage newspaper editorial collage assembled from cut photographic silhouettes, torn newsprint deckle edges, aged sepia paper grain, and muted monochrome ink layers.

options.label: 🔺 Constructivist Photomontage Poster (Diagonal Red, Black & Cream)
options.rule: Constructivist printed photomontage poster combining sharp cutout photographic figures with dynamic diagonal red, black, and warm cream geometric fields and coarse print grain.

options.label: 📖 Layered Motion Comic (Held Illustrated Poses + Parallax Depth Planes)
options.rule: Layered digital motion-comic medium combining cleanly outlined illustrated characters in rhythmic stepped held poses across sliding flat background depth planes with selective comic screentones.

options.label: 🎎 Chinese Gongbi Silk Painting (Mineral Pigments & Fine Brush Ink)
options.rule: Meticulous traditional Chinese gongbi painting on warm silk: delicate fine-brush ink outlines filled with translucent mineral blues, malachite greens, and cinnabar reds.

options.label: 🖌️ Traditional Ink Wash on Xuan Paper (Calligraphic Brush & Negative Space)
options.rule: Expressive traditional ink-wash animation on absorbent xuan rice paper with fluid calligraphic brushstrokes, soft wet-bleed gradients, generous negative space, and a single vermilion seal accent.

options.label: 🎨 Fauvist Bold Gouache & Oil (Rough Saturated Complementary Brushwork)
options.rule: Vibrant Fauvist gouache-and-oil painting in motion: broad rough expressive brushstrokes and flattened bold complementary colors pulsing across every surface.

options.label: 🌩️ German Expressionist Angular Oil (Coarse Strokes & Slanted Shadows)
options.rule: Tense Expressionist oil-painted cinema: coarse angular brushstrokes, elongated dramatic shadow wedges, deep chiaroscuro contrasts, and charged palette-knife texture.

options.label: 🔷 Analytic Cubist Painted Planes (Overlapping Geometric Facets)
options.rule: Analytic Cubist oil painting in fluid motion, reconstructing subjects and architecture out of crisp overlapping painted geometric planes, ochre-slate facets, and fragmented edges.

options.label: 🌿 Ornate Art Nouveau Lithograph (Whiplash Curves & Botanical Gold)
options.rule: Ornate Art Nouveau lithographic poster brought to life with flowing whiplash ink contours, muted sage and burnished gold tones, luminous skin shading, and botanical decorative motifs.

options.label: 📺 Datamosh Compression Melt (Dragging Motion-Vector Pixel Trails)
options.rule: Pronounced digital datamosh compression-melt aesthetic with large rectangular motion-vector pixel trails dragging across silhouettes and vivid cyan-magenta codec smear.

options.label: 🪞 Liquid Chrome / Mercury World (Mirror Specular Surfaces)
options.rule: Sleek liquid chrome and polished mercury aesthetic where figures and surroundings gleam as fluid silver mirror surfaces reflecting crisp high-contrast highlights.

options.label: 💎 Translucent Holographic Glass World (Iridescent Cyan/Pink Refraction)
options.rule: Luminous translucent holographic glass medium with crisp iridescent cyan, pink, and violet caustic refractions glowing through every silhouette.

options.label: 🏮 Backlit Paper Shadow Box Diorama (Pierced Cardstock & Warm Glow)
options.rule: Intricate backlit paper shadow-box miniature built from stacked pierced cardstock planes bathed in warm golden transmitted light and soft cool silhouette shadows.
